w:r.w:t: person is actively interacting with their environment, taking in content, following objects
Conscious perception isn’t a constant spotlight but a shifting beam.
It flickers between internal signals (thoughts, memories, emotions) and external input (sensory data, events, people). The mind reallocates attention in real time
awareness rests, but how often and how intensely it swings. Rapid oscillations between inner and outer focus can shape experience just as much as prolonged absorption in either one.
